name: Nanase Rin
source:
Her surname used to be Yuuki in Milkyway.

She is the older sister of [url=/c20356]Yuuki Ran[/url]

Is the mother of [url=/c20360]Nanase Kira[/url] in Milkyway 3.

She is the adoptive aunt of [url=/c20364]Yuuki Setsuka[/url] in Milkyway 3, who was adopted by Ran.
